project_description: Add optional GeoIP-based HTTP ingress access control for Go-LIP. Enforce country and IP/CIDR allow/deny policy before general tracing, metrics, access logging, authentication, frontend decoding, routing, database work, or model execution; preserve exact Apache-style deny_allow / allow_deny semantics; support IPv4/IPv6 overrides and explicit trusted reverse-proxy client-IP resolution; use an enforceably immutable generation policy and a local MaxMind-compatible Country MMDB service with bounded parsing/update resources, crash-durable transactional last-known-good publication, deterministic recovery, and updater/shutdown serialization; make pure policy reloadable through immutable request-plane generations while keeping MMDB/updater lifecycle process-owned. Preserve the process-owned management listener, network-free runtimebundle.ValidateStructural check-config path, and existing in-flight generation pinning. Track implementation under GitHub issue #387.
